notes: Page 41 is a title slide and page 45 a hands-on launch demo; both are merged or skipped. Exam guide emphasis: Task 3.2/4.2 make instance family selection and purchasing-option trade-offs the most tested items — expect distractors that swap Reserved vs Savings Plans flexibility and Capacity Resat Reservations vs Reserved pricing. Task 1.2 makes security groups high-value: remember timeout = security group, refused = application; inbound denied by default, outbound allowed by default. Discount percentages (72%, 66%, 90%) are illustrative only; do not memorize exact figures. Spot Fleet strategies and the cancel-then-terminate sequence are common scenario traps. Background: Spot Fleet is largely superseded by EC2 Auto Scaling mixed-instance policies, but the allocation strategy names remain examinable.
